summary: Add factual, provider-neutral channel unit economics with immutable digests, explicit quality states and tenant-safe reporting without moving financial source-of-truth ownership.

impacts.evidence: Channel mappings, costs, runs and quality issues use organization/workspace keys and forced RLS.
Only bounded channel/source references and digests are stored; raw provider and customer payloads are excluded.
The report catalog and bounded filters are extended additively under /api/v1/reports.
Snapshot request/published payload schemas are additive canonical events without financial payload dumps.
No connector SDK contract changes; channel attribution is resolved at the host boundary.
Migration 34 adds expand-only channel, cost and immutable run metadata tables.
RLS, bounded filters, no-store exports and no-secret evidence are required.
The report is read-only and cannot mutate ledger, ads, payments or channel mapping.
Each result carries source refs, input digest and versioned policies.
Provider-reference settlement deduplication and deterministic run keys make replay safe.
Calculation and report queries perform no external network egress.
Coverage, quality and report freshness are explicit output fields for alerting.
Derived readers can be disabled while immutable evidence is retained.
Core tests cover deterministic arithmetic, dedup, overflow, mixed currency and incomplete facts.
